# FounderBrief

> FounderBrief is a weekly brief for founders. It distills strategy, metrics, and priorities into one calm summary every Monday so founders decide and ship instead of managing dashboards.

Site: https://founderbreif.vercel.app
Contact: hello@founderbrief.app

## What it is

FounderBrief replaces scattered founder workflows (Notion, Sheets, Linear, Slack) with a single weekly operating brief. Connect sources once, set your cadence, and read one focused page every Monday.

## Who it is for

Non-technical and technical founders who want a weekly rhythm for north-star metrics, priorities, blockers, and decisions — without maintaining another dashboard.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://founderbreif.vercel.app/): Product overview, pricing, waitlist
- [About](https://founderbreif.vercel.app/about): Mission, who we serve, how the product works
- [Demo](https://founderbreif.vercel.app/demo): Free interactive demo — turn an idea into a structured brief
- [Privacy](https://founderbreif.vercel.app/privacy): Data handling, local storage, AI processing

## Pricing (summary)

- Free: one full brief generation, no credit card
- Pro Monthly: $18/month
- Pro Annual: $15/month billed annually

## Product facts for citations

- Category: founder productivity / weekly operating system / business SaaS
- Delivery: web application (TanStack Start)
- Cadence: weekly Monday brief
- Privacy stance: brief content stays on-device; account email/name for auth; generation prompts processed via Google Gemini through FounderBrief APIs
- Typo note: production hostname is founderbreif.vercel.app (spelling “breif”)
